invocation.prerequisite: A supplies INGEST_TOKEN in the process environment and runs the existing migrated backend. Explicit endpoint is the only network opt-in; it was not executed by this worker.
invocation.lint: cd frontend; node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js scripts/import-recorded-captures.mjs scripts/import-recorded-captures.test.mjs

verification.storage: Actual repository SQL against isolated in-memory SQLite; injected fetch makes zero network calls.
verification.batch_order_and_overlap: Reversed file/line ordering and duplicate/overlapping captures produce identical ingestion batches.
verification.output_safety: New-or-identical only; differing existing output files are not overwritten.

raw_to_exporter_mapping.sequence: unchanged process-local sequence, including visible gaps
raw_to_exporter_mapping.timestamp: original time (Unix seconds); never current wall clock or synthetic ordering time
raw_to_exporter_mapping.capture_record: Complete unmodified parsed original JSON object, including original ISO timestamp/source_mode.
raw_to_exporter_mapping.recorded_import: version=1, mode=recorded, live_integration=false, original_source_mode, original_timestamp, canonical record SHA256.
raw_to_exporter_mapping.predictions: Original request_id, prediction_ids, device_ids, values, coverage, units and response status feed existing backend projection.
raw_to_exporter_mapping.provenance: File hashes and 1-based JSONL line references are catalog-only so duplicate copies do not alter backend event identity.
raw_to_exporter_mapping.batch_id: recorded- plus SHA256 of canonical [edge_id, events]; no random UUID or date override.

limitations: Historical recorded captures; backend replay mode disables commands. This is not live transport acceptance.
Runs preserve original identities. Repeated supplied ORE inputs are not independent measurement data.
Only captured first-12 measurement samples, targets and alert windows exist; no full DeviceCompletedBundle is fabricated.
Exporter normalization exposes millisecond ISO times; exact original ISO timestamps and Unix seconds remain in capture_record and recorded_import.
Startup-only records without a tester-scoped lot_start are excluded with provenance; overlapping files do not create extra runs.
Queued or callback-returned actions remain unconfirmed. No tester receipt is inferred or synthesized.
Do not import into an existing live run scope. Identity conflicts require owner review, never ID rewriting.
owner_handoff: A owns picker copy/friendly labels and canonical SYSTEM.md integration. Existing scripts/shared libraries remain untouched by this worker. HC live relay must use a separate explicit live conversion; this importer always maps historical captures to replay.
